summary: Independently re-ran every cell and file this lane's fix round (wave1-lane10-fixround-1.md, head 01e74503) cited as evidence, on the lane rig (PGPORT 55750, clara_l10, Playwright 3590/3591/3592), and re-read the code each finding named. All six review findings addressed in the fix round (L10-A1 through L10-A6) hold: periodic-adjustment-e2e.mjs (6 legs) and staff-expense-claim-e2e.mjs (7 legs) both pass solo with the destructured-detail assertion in place (L10-A1); apps/web/lib/work/api.ts spreads carrier(body) into retryWork, cancelWork and takeOverWork's refusal arms and lib/work/api.test.ts is 27/27 (L10-A2); the shared harness's ask_question arm is gated by CLARA_WORK_ASK_ONLY_CLIENT (REQUIRED, fail-closed) and trade-invoice-e2e.mjs leg 6 passes with its added bystander-Work assertion (L10-A3); workRoutes.ts's header now states the true CONSTRAINT_FOLD_REASONS set instead of the disproven claim (L10-A4); the gate-directory rmSync is gone, .gitignore carries both gate paths, and git status is clean after a full trade-invoice-e2e run (L10-A5); and the walk's control body now sends the whole typed refusal object, with trade-invoice-walk e2e still 12/12 (L10-A6). The spec-lens review's F1 (AC4/narrate-leg reproduction failure) is REFUTED on two more solo re-runs of work-journal-e2e.mjs, both all-8-legs-green including leg 4 (44.0s-class run twice more here), consistent with the fix round's cross-process-contention explanation rather than a lane defect; F2 (World-e2e rig contention) needed no code change and none was made, matching the review's own ask. Nothing broken: pnpm typecheck exit 0, pnpm lint exit 0, node scripts/check-frozen-workflows.mjs OK (312 frozen files, no manifest diff, confirming --print-closure stays clear of NON-FROZEN scope), packages/runtime/scripts/check-parts-parity.mjs OK, the four runtime unit files 79/79, and the whole apps/web unit suite reproduced EXACTLY the fix round's own counts (4638 tests, 135 suites, 4636 pass, 0 fail, 2 skip). Working tree is clean at every checkpoint; nothing was pushed, committed, or edited by this review. Two items the fix round itself flagged as deliberately not worked remain open, both at or below minor: L10-A7 (workRoutes.ts's unnamed-409 fallback comment near the answer(409,{error:"conflict"}) arm at :1053 still does not say the promoted/full-body distinction the review asked for) and L10-A8 (seven of the eleven work-journal-serve.mjs spawners are still not run on a lane rig, which the review itself said needed no fix beyond L10-A1 and is the orchestrator's job). Neither is new; both were disclosed as not-worked in the fix round's own 'Deliberately left' section. Verdict accept: nothing above minor remains open.
